facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.gen_vocab: train a SentencePiece BPE vocabulary model from a text file and export a fairseq dictionary
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.extract_fbank_features: extract Kaldi-compliant fbank features from a waveform tensor and optionally save to numpy file
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_zip: create a zip archive of all numpy and flac files in a data directory
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.get_zip_manifest: generate a manifest of paths and lengths for all files inside a zip archive
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.gen_config_yaml: generate a speech-to-text data configuration YAML file with vocab, specaugment, and CMVN settings

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.run_COVOST_PREP: run the CoVoST data preparation script to extract features and generate manifests for speech-to-text
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_COVOST_DATASET: create a CoVoST dataset instance to load speech translation samples with waveform and translation data
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.process_COVOST_DATA: process CoVoST data by extracting fbank features, creating ZIP archives, and generating TSV manifests
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.build_COVOST_MANIFEST: build TSV manifest files from CoVoST dataset splits with audio paths and target text
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.generate_COVOST_CONFIG: generate a config YAML and vocabulary model for CoVoST speech-to-text or ASR tasks

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.run_librispeech_prep: run the script to download LibriSpeech data and prepare fbank features and TSV manifests
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.build_librispeech_dataset: build a LibriSpeech dataset with extracted fbank features, vocab, and config for speech-to-text training
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_fbank_features: create log mel filter bank features from LibriSpeech audio WAV files and pack them into a ZIP archive
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.generate_tsv_manifests: generate TSV manifest files for each LibriSpeech split with audio paths, frame counts, and text
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.generate_speech_vocab: generate a SentencePiece vocabulary model from LibriSpeech training text with a specified vocab size

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.run_mtedx_data_prep: run the mTEDx data preparation script to process multilingual TEDx audio and text data for ASR or ST tasks
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_mtedx_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset for Multilingual TEDx that yields waveform, sample rate, source utterance, target utterance, speaker id, and utterance id tuples
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.process_mtedx_per_langpair: process mTEDx data per language pair by extracting audio features or fbank features, zipping, and generating TSV manifests
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.process_mtedx_joint: process all mTEDx language pairs jointly by generating a shared vocabulary with language tags and creating symlinked manifests
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.review_mtedx_class: review the mTEDx Dataset class that loads YAML segments and utterance text files to build indexed audio-utterance pairs

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.run_mustc_data_prep: run the MuST-C data preparation script to extract features and generate manifests for speech-to-text tasks
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.run_mustc_joint_vocab: run the joint processing to build a shared vocabulary across all 8 MuST-C languages
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_mustc_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset for MuST-C that yields waveforms, sample rates, and source and target utterances
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.extract_fbank_features: extract log mel filter bank features from audio waveforms and save them as numpy arrays
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.generate_mustc_manifests: generate TSV manifest files and config YAML for MuST-C data splits with vocabulary and normalization settings
